title: Jalen Farmer Gives the Colts More Flexibility Across the OL

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jalen Farmer Gives the Colts More Flexibility Across the OL
sources.description: Jalen Farmer and the impending competition on the offensive line. Death. Taxes. And Chris Ballard being stubborn about the offensive line. The Colts kicked off their day three of the NFL draft by selecting Jalen Farmer— the big guard from Kentucky. Judging from the behind-the-scenes video that the Colts released, the Colts LOVE this guy. […]
